title: Cardholder Agreement Terms on Interest Charges, Minimum Payments and Special Financing — Northgate Card
content:
These terms govern interest and statements on every **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account.

**1. Interest charge.** Interest is charged at each statement close by the average daily balance method including new purchases: the daily periodic rate is the purchase APR divided by 100 and then by the card's interest divisor, applied to the average daily balance of the cycle multiplied by the number of days in the cycle, rounded half up to the cent. The billing cycle runs from the day after the previous statement closing date through the current closing date; the average daily balance is the average of the end-of-day purchase balances of each day in that cycle, including new purchases on their posting date and excluding amounts under billing-error dispute and special financing balances inside their promotional period; the days in the cycle are its calendar days. Interest is computed by the card's interest method, and grace depends on the previous balance as the card's grace term states.

*Hypothetical worked charge:* an average daily balance of 730.00 over a 30-day cycle at a 29.99% APR with the 365 divisor gives 730.00 multiplied by 0.2999, divided by 365, multiplied by 30, which is 17.994, charged as 17.99.

**2. Grace.** New purchases carry no interest in a cycle when the previous statement balance was paid in full by its payment due date.

**3. Disputed amounts.** Amounts under billing-error dispute are excluded from the balance on which interest accrues while the dispute is open.

**4. Minimum interest charge.** When any interest is due and the computed amount is below the card's minimum interest charge, the minimum charge applies instead (charged as a minimum interest charge). Hypothetical illustration: a computed interest of 1.20 on a card with a 2.00 minimum is charged as 2.00; a computed interest of 0.00, with no interest due, is not raised to 2.00.

**5. Special financing.** A special financing purchase carries no billed interest during its promotional period; if any of it remains unpaid at the end of the period, the interest accrued from the purchase date at the purchase APR is charged on the statement after the period ends (charged as deferred interest), and nothing is charged if it was paid in full. During the last two billing cycles before a promotional period ends, payment above the minimum is applied first to that promotional balance. Special financing is offered only on tiers with special financing periods, on a single Northgate purchase of at least the tier's smallest eligible purchase.

**6. Cash advances.** Cash advances accrue interest from the transaction date at the cash advance APR with no grace period.

**7. Statement figures.** Each statement shows the new balance, the minimum payment due and the payment due date, which is the card's number of payment-due days after the closing date, counted in calendar days. The minimum payment due is the greater of the card's minimum payment floor and the card's minimum payment percentage of the new balance excluding disputed amounts plus that cycle's interest and fees, but never more than the new balance.

*Hypothetical worked minimum:* on a consumer card with a 40.00 floor and 1%, a new balance of 1500.00 of which 200.00 is in dispute, with 20.00 of interest and fees in the cycle: 1% of 1300.00 is 13.00, plus 20.00 is 33.00; the greater of 40.00 and 33.00 is 40.00, which is not more than the new balance. On a new balance of 25.00 the minimum is 25.00, because it is never more than the new balance.

**8. Other terms.** No penalty APR is ever applied since a penalty APR can never be applied on any card, no annual fee is charged beyond the card's annual fee, and purchases processed outside the US carry the card's foreign transaction fee on Mastercard tiers. An APR increase or other significant change in terms takes effect only after the card's notice days' written notice and applies only to transactions made after it takes effect.
